name: Validate Frontend Code on Save
description: Checks React/JS files for anti-patterns and coding standard violations when saved

then.prompt: Check the edited file for violations of our coding standards: (1) Components must not call APIs directly — they should use hooks from src/hooks/ which use the service layer. (2) Hooks must handle loading/error/success states and include useEffect cleanup. (3) useCallback for stable references, useMemo for expensive computations. (4) Missing accessibility: labels, aria attributes, semantic HTML, role='alert' on errors. (5) JSDoc comments on exported functions/components. Only report actual issues found.
